Sergeant '''Mokem''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] living on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], displaced passengers from the [[Crescent (freighter)|''Crescent'']] fled [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] and sought shelter in the nearby [[Lianorm Swamp/Legends|Lianorm Swamp]]. A Gungan patrol led by Mokem halted the refugees and escorted them to the edge of the swamp, refusing to allow them to travel any deeper.<ref name="Peril on Naboo" />

The Gungan surname "Mokem" means, "greatful guest."<ref name="Galactic Campaign Guide">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
